_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision every sim/*/records/*.md in this repo traces to. Read by sim/tools/pdk_identity.py (release_tag, variant) as the fail-closed identity check; the rest is a greppable fact sheet. Shape adapted from sg13g2-lna/sim/pdk.json (same PDK, same release); see spec/decision-records/0001-adopt-lna-sim-env.md.
fetch_method: scripts/setup-env.sh -> klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (2AMLogic/klayout-tools, commit pinned in scripts/setup-env.sh)
fetched_version_marker: PDK_ROOT/.fetched-version (written by the fetch script beside the ihp-sg13g2/ dir); pdk_identity.py also accepts PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/.fetched-version

models_used.npn13G2: native ngspice VBIC (level=9) card in sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib, loaded through cornerHBT.lib sections (hbt_typ etc.); no OSDI. Smoke exercises hbt_typ only; the HBT corner box is the spec's (#2).
models_used.sg13_lv_nmos: PSP103.6 Verilog-A via OSDI, cornerMOSlv.lib sections mos_tt / mos_ff / mos_ss / mos_fs / mos_sf
models_used.sg13_lv_pmos: same library and OSDI object as sg13_lv_nmos
